_doc: First match on the SUBJECT wins (regex, case-insensitive). urgent = Telegram now; daily = evening summary (only sent if something is in it); quiet = log only. Add a rule whenever the owner says a message is too noisy or too slow.

rules.match: need(s)? you|waiting on you|action needed|approval needed|not replied|unanswered
rules.why: a person has to do something
something broke, will break soon, or is waiting for an OK
